📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-25
1. Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO 11 days after he left產業
Nvidia 董事會宣布黃仁勳回鍋，離職 11 天後重掌執行長職務
Nvidia announced on Monday (11/23) that Huang is restored as president, CEO and director, ending an 11-day absence. Reports say talks began Saturday, he agreed to return Sunday, and President Trump personally got involved.
Nvidia 周一（11/23）宣布黃仁勳恢復總裁、執行長及董事職務，結束 11 天的離職風波。據媒體報導，雙方上周六開始協商、周日決定復職，美國總統川普也親自介入。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180739
2. Anthropic launches Claude Ship to review, fix and approve code automatically產品
Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship，AI 自動審查、修正及核准程式碼
Claude Ship extends AI coding from writing code to the delivery pipeline. Claude can review and fix pull requests and approve changes under a company's own policies. It is in testing for Claude Team and Enterprise users.
Claude Ship 把 AI 程式開發從撰寫程式碼延伸到軟體交付流程，能自動審查及修正 PR，並依企業自訂政策核准變更。目前開放 Claude Team 與 Enterprise 用戶測試。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180741
3. AI Solved Math's Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It研究
AI 解開數學最著名難題，人類卻難以理解
An Anthropic researcher produced a 17-million-line "alien" solution to the Riemann hypothesis. Mathematicians say it will take months to understand.
一位 Anthropic 研究員產出了黎曼猜想的 1,700 萬行「外星風格」解答，數學家表示需要數月時間才能理解。
Wired · https://www.wired.com/story/ai-solved-maths-most-famous-problem/
4. CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion, a security-industry record產業
CrowdStrike 以 439 億美元併購 Zscaler，創資安界交易紀錄
iThome's 11/24 security daily leads with CrowdStrike's $43.9B deal for Zscaler, the largest in the security industry. It also covers the Shopline data exposure and the incomplete PHP2Shell fix (phpAfterShell).
iThome 11/24 資安日報頭條為 CrowdStrike 以 439 億美元併購 Zscaler，創資安界最大交易紀錄。另報導 Shopline 出貨資訊疑遭未授權存取，以及 PHP2Shell 修補不完整的 phpAfterShell 漏洞。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180756
5. Microsoft launches "Code Red" to restore global outages within one hour產業
微軟啟動紅色警戒計畫，目標 1 小時內修復全球服務故障
After this month's global Microsoft 365 outage, Microsoft has started an internal Code Red program to overhaul outage prevention and response. The goal is global recovery within one hour for major incidents.
本月 Microsoft 365 全球大規模當機後，微軟內部啟動紅色警戒計畫，全面改革故障預防與應變機制，目標是未來重大事故能在 1 小時內完成全球服務修復。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180785
6. Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited a 0-day with little human input資安
Amazon 表示駭客的 AI 代理人在極少人為介入下發現並利用零時差漏洞
The Cairn AI framework is proving to be a boon for both defenders and attackers.
Cairn AI 框架對防守方與攻擊方都成為助力。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/amazon-says-hackers-ai-agents-found-and-exploited-0-day-with-little-human-input/
7. GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities模型
GPT-6 模型展現內在的蛋白質設計能力
GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.
GPT-6 模型運用推理與程式碼設計蛋白質結構與序列，實驗室測試在五個標靶上發現結合的證據。
OpenAI · https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-models-demonstrate-intrinsic-protein-design-capabilities
8. Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month政策
Tidal 下月起禁止 AI 生成音樂
Tidal will ban fully AI-generated music on December 9th. It will delete around 29 million AI songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks a day, according to its music lead.
Tidal 將於 12 月 9 日起禁止純 AI 生成音樂，依其音樂主管說法，將刪除約 2,900 萬首 AI 歌曲，並每天拒絕約 8 萬至 8.5 萬首投稿。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1041362/tidal-ai-music-ban
9. Amazon acquires Decart's compute-optimization tech to boost its Trainium chips產業
Amazon 收購 Decart AI 運算最佳化技術，延攬核心研發團隊
Amazon will acquire the compute-optimization technology of Israeli startup Decart AI and hire its three co-founders and core R&D team. The aim is to improve its in-house AI chips and cut training and inference costs.
Amazon 宣布收購以色列新創 Decart AI 的運算最佳化技術，並延攬 3 名共同創辦人及核心研發團隊，以提升自研 AI 晶片效能、降低訓練與推論成本。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180751
10. Broadcom patches 23 VMware flaws, including a critical vCenter authentication bypass資安
Broadcom 修補 VMware 產品 23 個漏洞，含影響 vCenter 的身分驗證繞過重大漏洞
Broadcom's 11/24 advisory fixes 23 flaws across ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion and Avi Load Balancer. The worst is the vCenter authentication bypass CVE-2026-123903, rated CVSS 9.8.
Broadcom 於 11/24 發布公告，修補 ESX、vCenter、Workstation、Fusion 及 Avi Load Balancer 共 23 個漏洞，最嚴重的是 vCenter 身分驗證繞過漏洞 CVE-2026-123903，CVSS 達 9.8。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180786
